name: Payment
doc:
The Payment module provides a generic, provider-agnostic subscription and billing system built on top of Stripe. It manages subscription plans, checkout sessions, customer portal sessions, webhook event handling, and per-plan feature/usage limits. The module is fully multi-tenant and domain-scoped, making it reusable across any LiWE3 application that needs recurring billing.

Stripe keys (dev and prod) and redirect URLs are stored as domain-scoped settings so each tenant or super-admin can configure them independently without touching environment variables.

The limits system is intentionally generic: each plan carries a JSON `limits` field whose keys (e.g. `max_users`, `max_storage_mb`) are defined by the consuming application. The module provides endpoints and events to check and broadcast those limits; the business rules live in the application layer.

## Provider abstraction
All Stripe calls are encapsulated in the method implementations inside `f2c_start`/`f2c_end` blocks. Swapping the provider only requires changing those blocks and the settings keys - the types, endpoints, permissions, and events remain stable.
short_descr: Generic Stripe-based subscription and billing module

typ.mpay0001.pln1.name: PaymentPlan
typ.mpay0001.pln1.description: A subscription plan with pricing tiers and optional Stripe price IDs for both monthly and annual billing cycles. Stored in the `payment_plans` table.
typ.mpay0001.pln1.doc: Each plan carries a `limits` JSON field whose schema is application-defined (e.g. `{"max_users": 5, "max_storage_mb": 1024}`). The payment module does not interpret limit keys; it only stores and returns them. Enforcement logic belongs to the application layer.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique plan identifier (slug-style, e.g. 'free', 'pro', 'enterprise')

fields.name: domain
fields.description: Domain that owns this plan (multi-tenant isolation)

fields.name: name
fields.description: Human-readable plan name

fields.name: description
fields.description: Optional plan description shown to users

fields.name: monthly_cost
fields.description: Monthly price in the account's default currency (e.g. 9.99)

fields.name: annual_cost
fields.description: Annual (yearly) price in the account's default currency

fields.name: stripe_price_monthly_id
fields.description: Stripe Price ID for the monthly billing cycle in production mode

fields.name: stripe_price_annual_id
fields.description: Stripe Price ID for the annual billing cycle in production mode

fields.name: stripe_test_price_monthly_id
fields.description: Stripe Price ID for the monthly billing cycle in test/dev mode

fields.name: stripe_test_price_annual_id
fields.description: Stripe Price ID for the annual billing cycle in test/dev mode

fields.name: limits
fields.description: Application-defined JSON limits for this plan (e.g. {"max_users": 5, "max_storage_mb": 1024}). Keys are opaque to the payment module.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the plan was created

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the plan was last updated

typ.mpay0002.sub1.name: Subscription
typ.mpay0002.sub1.description: The current subscription state for a user or tenant. Not stored as its own table - derived from user/tenant fields updated by webhook events.
typ.mpay0002.sub1.doc: This type is returned by `GET /payment/subscription`. It is a read-only projection: the payment module updates subscription fields on the user or tenant record (via the `payment.subscription.updated` event) whenever Stripe sends a webhook. The application layer maps those fields to this shape.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Subscription status: 'active' | 'canceled' | 'suspended' | 'none'

fields.name: plan_id
fields.description: The plan ID that is currently active (e.g. 'free', 'pro', 'enterprise')

fields.name: interval
fields.description: Billing interval: 'monthly' | 'annual'

fields.name: expires_at
fields.description: Date/time when the current billing period ends

fields.name: cancel_at_period_end
fields.description: If true the subscription will not renew when the current period ends

fields.name: plan
fields.description: Full plan details (joined from payment_plans), available when the plan_id matches a stored plan

typ.mpay0003.cs01.name: CheckoutSession
typ.mpay0003.cs01.description: Result of creating a Stripe Checkout session. The client must redirect the user to the returned URL.
typ.mpay0003.cs01.doc: Returned by `POST /payment/checkout`. The URL points to a Stripe-hosted checkout page. On completion, Stripe redirects back to the configured `success_url`.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Stripe Checkout URL - redirect the user here to complete payment

typ.mpay0004.ps01.name: PortalSession
typ.mpay0004.ps01.description: Result of creating a Stripe Customer Portal session. The client must redirect the user to the returned URL.
typ.mpay0004.ps01.doc: Returned by `POST /payment/portal`. The URL points to the Stripe-hosted customer portal where the user can update payment methods, change plans, or cancel. On exit, Stripe redirects back to the configured `return_url`.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Stripe Customer Portal URL - redirect the user here to manage their subscription

typ.mpay0005.ld01.name: LimitDefinition
typ.mpay0005.ld01.description: Describes one application-defined limit key that plans can restrict. Returned by GET /payment/limits-definitions so the frontend can display human-readable labels.
typ.mpay0005.ld01.doc: The payment module stores limit definitions as a domain-scoped setting (key: `payment_limits_definition`). Applications seed their own definitions (e.g. `max_users`, `max_storage_mb`) at startup via the admin endpoint.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Limit key name (e.g. 'max_users')

fields.name: label
fields.description: Human-readable label (e.g. 'Team Members')

fields.name: description
fields.description: Optional longer description of what this limit controls

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Optional unit label for display (e.g. 'MB', 'users', 'requests/month')

typ.mpay0006.lc01.name: LimitCheck
typ.mpay0006.lc01.description: Result of checking whether a specific usage limit would be exceeded.
typ.mpay0006.lc01.doc: Returned by `GET /payment/limits/check`. The application layer provides `current` usage; the module compares it against the active plan's limit for that key.

fields.name: allowed
fields.description: True if the operation is within the plan's limit

fields.name: limit
fields.description: The plan's limit value for this key (-1 means unlimited)

fields.name: current
fields.description: The current usage value passed by the caller

fields.name: key
fields.description: The limit key that was checked (e.g. 'max_users')

typ.mpay0007.st01.name: PaymentSettings
typ.mpay0007.st01.description: Stripe configuration keys for a domain. Stored in the generic settings table, not in a dedicated table.
typ.mpay0007.st01.doc: Settings are stored under well-known keys in the system settings store (e.g. `payment.stripe_dev_api_key`). Both dev/test and production keys are kept separately so the module can switch based on the current environment flag. `success_url` and `cancel_url` support `{domain}` and `{subdomain}` placeholders.

fields.name: stripe_dev_api_key
fields.description: Stripe secret API key for test/dev mode (sk_test_...)

fields.name: stripe_dev_webhook_secret
fields.description: Stripe webhook signing secret for test/dev mode (whsec_...)

fields.name: stripe_prod_api_key
fields.description: Stripe secret API key for production mode (sk_live_...)

fields.name: stripe_prod_webhook_secret
fields.description: Stripe webhook signing secret for production mode (whsec_...)

fields.name: stripe_success_url
fields.description: URL to redirect to after successful checkout. Supports {domain} and {subdomain} placeholders.

fields.name: stripe_cancel_url
fields.description: URL to redirect to when the user cancels checkout. Supports {domain} and {subdomain} placeholders.

fields.name: stripe_portal_return_url
fields.description: URL to redirect to when the user exits the Customer Portal. Supports {domain} and {subdomain} placeholders.

typ.mpay0008.wr01.name: WebhookResult
typ.mpay0008.wr01.description: Acknowledgment returned by the webhook endpoint to Stripe.
typ.mpay0008.wr01.doc: Stripe requires a 2xx response with a JSON body to confirm receipt. Any non-2xx response causes Stripe to retry the event.

fields.name: received
fields.description: Always true when the webhook was processed without error

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: The Stripe event type that was processed (e.g. 'checkout.session.completed')

perm.mpay0001.pc01.name: payment.plan.create
perm.mpay0001.pc01.description: Can create or update a subscription plan

perm.mpay0003.pl01.name: payment.plan.list
perm.mpay0003.pl01.description: Can list all plans including private Stripe IDs and test keys (admin-level view)

perm.mpay0004.sm01.name: payment.subscription.manage
perm.mpay0004.sm01.description: Can initiate checkout, open customer portal, and cancel subscriptions

perm.mpay0005.sv01.name: payment.subscription.view
perm.mpay0005.sv01.description: Can view the current subscription status and plan details

perm.mpay0006.ss01.name: payment.settings.manage
perm.mpay0006.ss01.description: Can read and write Stripe API keys and webhook secrets

perm.mpay0007.ld01.name: payment.limits.define
perm.mpay0007.ld01.description: Can create or update limit definitions (what limit keys mean)

evt.mpay0001.sc01.name: payment.subscription.created
evt.mpay0001.sc01.description: A new subscription became active for the first time (checkout.session.completed or invoice.payment_succeeded on a new subscription). Payload: { id_user, plan_id, interval, expires_at, domain }

evt.mpay0002.su01.name: payment.subscription.updated
evt.mpay0002.su01.description: An existing subscription changed plan, interval, status, or renewal date (customer.subscription.updated or invoice.payment_succeeded on renewal). Payload: { id_user, plan_id, status, interval, expires_at, cancel_at_period_end, domain }

evt.mpay0003.sx01.name: payment.subscription.canceled
evt.mpay0003.sx01.description: A subscription was permanently canceled and will not renew (customer.subscription.deleted). Payload: { id_user, plan_id, domain }

evt.mpay0004.cc01.name: payment.checkout.completed
evt.mpay0004.cc01.description: A Stripe Checkout session completed successfully (checkout.session.completed). Payload: { id_user, session_id, plan_id, interval, domain }

evt.mpay0005.wh01.name: payment.webhook.received
evt.mpay0005.wh01.description: A raw Stripe webhook event was received and signature-verified, before business logic runs. Useful for audit logging. Payload: { event_type, event_id, domain }

evt.mpay0006.pc01.name: payment.plan.created
evt.mpay0006.pc01.description: A new subscription plan was created by an admin. Payload: { plan_id, name, domain }

evt.mpay0007.pu01.name: payment.plan.updated
evt.mpay0007.pu01.description: An existing subscription plan was modified by an admin. Payload: { plan_id, name, domain }

evt.mpay0008.pd01.name: payment.plan.deleted
evt.mpay0008.pd01.description: A subscription plan was deleted by an admin. Payload: { plan_id, domain }

endp.mpay0101.pl01.description:
Returns all subscription plans visible to end users, ordered by monthly cost ascending.

Private fields (Stripe price IDs and test keys) are stripped from the response. Use `GET /payment/admin/plans` to retrieve the full record including Stripe IDs.

**Access:** Public (no authentication required)

endp.mpay0102.gs01.description:
Returns the active subscription for the authenticated user or tenant, including the plan details, billing interval, expiry date, and cancel-at-period-end flag.

If no subscription exists the response has `status: 'none'` and `plan_id: 'free'`.

**Access:** Logged-in user (`payment.subscription.view`)

endp.mpay0103.ck01.description:
Creates a Stripe-hosted Checkout session for the authenticated user to subscribe to the specified plan and billing interval.

The method resolves the correct Stripe Price ID (test vs. production, monthly vs. annual) from the plan record and Stripe settings. On success, returns a `CheckoutSession` with the URL the client must redirect to.

Stripe will send a `checkout.session.completed` webhook when payment succeeds, which updates the user's subscription automatically.

**Access:** `payment.subscription.manage`

parameters.name: plan_id
parameters.description: ID of the plan to subscribe to (must exist in payment_plans)

parameters.name: success_url
parameters.description: Override the default success redirect URL for this session (optional)

parameters.name: cancel_url
parameters.description: Override the default cancel redirect URL for this session (optional)

endp.mpay0104.po01.short_descr: Create a Stripe Customer Portal session
endp.mpay0104.po01.description:
Opens a Stripe Customer Portal session for the authenticated user. The portal lets the user update payment methods, view invoices, change plan, or cancel.

If `plan_id` and `interval` are provided, the portal is pre-configured with a subscription-update flow pointing directly at the specified plan, skipping the plan selection screen.

Returns a `PortalSession` with the URL the client must redirect to.

**Access:** `payment.subscription.manage`

parameters.name: plan_id
parameters.description: Optional target plan ID for a direct plan-upgrade flow in the portal

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Optional billing interval for the upgrade flow: 'monthly' or 'annual'

endp.mpay0105.ca01.short_descr: Cancel the active subscription at period end
endp.mpay0105.ca01.description:
Marks the authenticated user's active Stripe subscription to cancel at the end of the current billing period (`cancel_at_period_end = true`). The subscription remains active until expiry.

Stripe sends a `customer.subscription.updated` webhook with `cancel_at_period_end: true`, which the module processes to update the local subscription record and emit `payment.subscription.updated`.

**Access:** `payment.subscription.manage`

endp.mpay0106.wh01.description:
Receives and processes Stripe webhook events. The endpoint:
1. Verifies the `Stripe-Signature` header using HMAC-SHA256 (Web Crypto API, no external SDK required)
2. Emits `payment.webhook.received` for audit/logging
3. Dispatches to the appropriate internal handler based on event type:
   - `checkout.session.completed` → activates subscription
   - `invoice.payment_succeeded` → renews subscription
   - `customer.subscription.updated` → syncs status and flags
   - `customer.subscription.deleted` → cancels subscription
4. Emits `payment.subscription.created`, `.updated`, or `.canceled` as appropriate

This endpoint must be excluded from JWT authentication middleware. Register it before auth middleware in the app router.

**Access:** Public (Stripe calls this directly; security is enforced by signature verification)

endp.mpay0107.ld01.short_descr: Get limit key definitions for the active domain
endp.mpay0107.ld01.description:
Returns the list of application-defined limit key definitions for the current domain, as stored by the admin via `POST /payment/admin/limits-definitions`.

Frontends use this to render human-readable plan comparison tables (e.g. 'Max Team Members: 5 / unlimited').

**Access:** Logged-in user

endp.mpay0108.lc01.short_descr: Check whether a specific usage limit would be exceeded
endp.mpay0108.lc01.description:
Checks if a given current usage value fits within the authenticated user's active plan for the specified limit key.

The caller passes `key` (e.g. `max_users`) and `current` (e.g. `4`). The module looks up the active plan's `limits` JSON, reads the value for that key, and returns `{ allowed, limit, current, key }`.

A missing key or `null` value in the plan's limits means 'unlimited' (`limit: -1, allowed: true`).

This endpoint is intentionally thin - the calling application is responsible for computing `current` usage.

**Access:** Logged-in user

parameters.name: current
parameters.description: Current usage value to compare against the plan's limit

endp.mpay0201.al01.short_descr: Admin: list all plans with full Stripe IDs
endp.mpay0201.al01.description:
Returns all subscription plans for the domain, including all private Stripe Price IDs for both production and test environments. Intended for use by super-admins in the management UI.

**Access:** `payment.plan.list`

endp.mpay0202.ap01.short_descr: Admin: create a new subscription plan
endp.mpay0202.ap01.description:
Creates a new subscription plan record for the domain. The `id` must be a unique slug (alphanumeric and hyphens). Duplicate IDs within the same domain are rejected with 409.

Emits `payment.plan.created`.

**Access:** `payment.plan.create`

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique plan slug (e.g. 'pro', 'enterprise'). Alphanumeric and hyphens only.

parameters.name: stripe_price_monthly_id
parameters.description: Stripe production Price ID for monthly billing

parameters.name: stripe_price_annual_id
parameters.description: Stripe production Price ID for annual billing

parameters.name: stripe_test_price_monthly_id
parameters.description: Stripe test Price ID for monthly billing

parameters.name: stripe_test_price_annual_id
parameters.description: Stripe test Price ID for annual billing

endp.mpay0203.up01.short_descr: Admin: update an existing subscription plan
endp.mpay0203.up01.description:
Updates an existing plan. The `id` field identifies the plan to update and cannot itself be changed.

All fields except `id` are optional; omitted fields retain their current value.

Emits `payment.plan.updated`.

**Access:** `payment.plan.create`

parameters.name: stripe_price_monthly_id
parameters.description: Stripe production Price ID for monthly billing

parameters.name: stripe_price_annual_id
parameters.description: Stripe production Price ID for annual billing

parameters.name: stripe_test_price_monthly_id
parameters.description: Stripe test Price ID for monthly billing

parameters.name: stripe_test_price_annual_id
parameters.description: Stripe test Price ID for annual billing

endp.mpay0204.dp01.description:
Deletes a subscription plan. The operation is rejected with 409 if any user or entity in the domain currently has an active subscription referencing this plan ID, preventing orphaned references.

Emits `payment.plan.deleted`.

**Access:** `payment.plan.delete`

endp.mpay0205.gs01.description:
Returns the Stripe configuration for the current domain (API keys, webhook secrets, and redirect URLs).

Secret fields (`stripe_*_api_key`, `stripe_*_webhook_secret`) are masked in the response (returned as `***` if set, empty string if not set) to avoid accidental exposure in logs or browser network tabs.

**Access:** `payment.settings.manage`

endp.mpay0206.ss01.description:
Saves Stripe configuration for the current domain. All fields are optional; only provided (non-null) fields are written to the settings store. Sending an empty string for a key clears that setting.

Settings are stored with the prefix `payment.` in the system settings table, scoped to the current domain.

**Access:** `payment.settings.manage`

parameters.name: stripe_dev_webhook_secret
parameters.description: Stripe webhook signing secret for test/dev (whsec_...)

parameters.name: stripe_prod_webhook_secret
parameters.description: Stripe webhook signing secret for production (whsec_...)

endp.mpay0207.ld01.description:
Saves (replaces) the list of application-defined limit key definitions for the current domain. This list is stored as a JSON value in the settings store and returned by `GET /payment/limits-definitions`.

Example payload:
```json
[
  { "name": "max_users", "label": "Team Members", "description": "Maximum collaborators", "unit": "users" },
  { "name": "max_storage_mb", "label": "Storage", "description": "Total upload storage", "unit": "MB" }
]
```

Emits no event (pure configuration, not operational data).

**Access:** `payment.limits.define`

parameters.name: definitions
parameters.description: Array of LimitDefinition objects to store
